about_the_game:
Sip or Die is a psychological party horror game where every round could be your last.

You sit at the table. The Pigman watches. A set of numbered vials sits before you, some filled with water, some with poison. Choose wrong, and you’ll feel it. choose right, and someone else might not.

You’re not just gambling with luck, you’re gambling with life.
The Pigman worships the outcome, whispering in static and flickering light as the round unfolds.

Survive, manipulate, and watch your opponents crumble one sip at a time.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence, blood, and psychological horror.
Players participate in a lethal drinking game where characters may die from poisoning or electrocution.
Themes include fear, self-preservation, and dark psychological tension.
No sexual content is depicted.
